articleDraft.title: Academic Year 2027-2028 Secretary Of The Navy Tours With Industry Call For Applications For Enlisted
articleDraft.summary: Eligibility: (1) All active-duty E6-E9 Sailors. (2) Training and Administration of the Reserves (TAR) Sailors are eligible for the SNTWI program. (3) Sailors must have a minimum of 5 years of service as of 1 September 2027. (4) SNTWI participants must have distinguished themselves by their performance in their fields and have high potential for future leadership positions. Applicants must meet physical readiness standards. (5) Sailors in receipt of orders, or within three years of their projected separation date, are not eligible. b.

articleDraft.details:
This NAVADMIN announces the Academic Year (AY) 2027-2028 Secretary of the Navy Tours with Industry (SNTWI) program for Enlisted Sailors, per reference (a). This program is a unique and non-traditional opportunity for exceptional Sailors to work with partnering corporations. SNTWI fellows are immersed in industry to learn and observe corporate processes and leading practices.

Timeline. All AY27-28 applications are due to OPNAV N1-74 (Navy Education Branch) no later than 2359 EST Monday 11 January 2027. a. A selection panel will convene in January 2027. b.

Application process. Send requests for application templates and any questions to the Navy Fellowships Distro listed below. a. Applications require a Secretary of the Navy Tours with Industry Program Application (NAVPERS 1330/4), a curriculum vitae, biography, and endorsement letters from both your commanding officer and detailer. b.

Points of Contact. a. Application submission and program-specific questions: navy.fellowships@us.navy.mil b. Community-specific eligibility questions: please contact your detailer.

extractedSections.1: This NAVADMIN announces the Academic Year (AY) 2027-2028 Secretary of the Navy Tours with Industry (SNTWI) program for Enlisted Sailors, per reference (a). This program is a unique and non-traditional opportunity for exceptional Sailors to work with partnering corporations. SNTWI fellows are immersed in industry to learn and observe corporate processes and leading practices. Fellows will be matched with a company based on the fellows' background, experience, and learning objectives. The company will then place the fellow in a position that will best meet the fellows' goals and objectives within their organization. Knowledge gained as a SNTWI fellow will assist in bringing innovative ideas and proven practices back to the Navy. Current partner companies are listed below: Amazon Anduril Deloitte Fairbanks Morse Defense FedEx In-Q-Tel Lockheed Martin Marque Ventures Microsoft Orion Group (MOA Pending) Saronic (MOA Pending) SMIT Salvage a. Eligibility: (1) All active-duty E6-E9 Sailors. (2) Training and Administration of the Reserves (TAR) Sailors are eligible for the SNTWI program. (3) Sailors must have a minimum of 5 years of service as of 1 September 2027. (4) SNTWI participants must have distinguished themselves by their performance in their fields and have high potential for future leadership positions. Applicants must meet physical readiness standards. (5) Sailors in receipt of orders, or within three years of their projected separation date, are not eligible. b. Program information: Up to ten (10) Enlisted Sailors may be selected for the AY27-28 program. Fellowships will begin in August 2027 following a one-week orientation course. SNTWI tours are normally 11-12 months in length. c. Reutilization/Service obligation: SNTWI Fellows incur a service obligation that is three times (3x) the number of months of the fellowship. Service obligation begins upon completion of or withdrawal from the program. Individuals who would be unable to complete the service obligation are ineligible to apply.
extractedSections.2: Timeline. All AY27-28 applications are due to OPNAV N1-74 (Navy Education Branch) no later than 2359 EST Monday 11 January 2027. a. Sailors selected for the program can expect to be matched with a host in early spring and expect to transfer in July 2027.
